scope: Local deeper analysis of the frozen seven-day review capture; no production code or live changes.
historical_limit: 2219 retained plan snapshots over about 22.18h, not all seven days of decisions.

dst_learning.qualification: Learner transform isolated with min_samples=1; default median/rate limiting can damp one DST observation. No claim this happened live.

partial_quantile_buffer.qualification: Current D-C8 explicitly uses zero band for unlearned slots. Design risk, not deviation from current specification.

live_learning.qualification: Adjusted denominator is a descriptive approximation; source history/configuration epochs may further restrict eligibility. It does not certify all hours usable.

limitations: Conditional continuations are synthetic, not available forecast evidence.
Continuation keeps current trajectories fixed and uses the same DC-only tail policy; it does not solve a globally reoptimized extended horizon.
AC terminal credit is a valuation, not a promise reserve mode will immediately enable later AC.
A true upper-PV export reduction matters differently from borrowing end storage to reduce nominal import.

work_profile.explanation: incoming_ceiling count is derived exactly from the documented loop lengths, avoiding a wrapper on every innermost operation.

why: pass 1 @ 10-02 12:00: direct surplus, 60 min x 1000 W, battery share 10%

design_notes: 50Wh import slack and 50Wh storage tolerance never authorize unserved DC.
Compare candidate-specific identical PV vectors, source ownership, input snapshots and aligned physical grids.
Preserve intentional pass-3 nominal-only policy; do not add blanket full-horizon P10 vetoes.
Explicit manual feed-in is external intent: describe unsafe forecast or apply established execution protection, never publish a false automatic zero schedule as the actual manual setting.
A per-slot prototype catches demonstrated defects but cannot claim five-minute temporal protection until atomic deficit evidence is retained.

envelope_cache.limitation: Local timing is one sample on this machine. Identity-list experiment proves reuse; production should reuse the existing scoped probe key and test cancellation/cache boundaries.

pairwise_cycle: B outranks C: missing C price uses 600 > 550
C outranks A: missing C price uses 550 > 500
market_cycle.interpretation: The unknown C window is never used in the cycle case but suppresses the known high-price A window. Reducing only C demand changes allocation to A. This demonstrates a nontransitive comparison contract; it does not prove a global economic optimum. Different load densities also produce different complete-step rounding and residual export.

limits: Synthetic scenarios do not prove measured real-world savings or incidents.
Archive week sizes extrapolate about 22.18h of retained events.
Envelope cache reduces work but measured wall time did not improve.
ABA probe artificially delays client callWS while current backend handler is synchronous.
DST transformation isolates one sample; default quantiles and damping can reduce the observed bias.
